question: A entrees identiques (S1 5m), une sortie reevaluee a chaque cloture de barre (B stop suiveur, C sortie adaptative) ameliore-t-elle le net par rapport a la sortie fixe A ? Stop obligatoire.

entry.atr: ATR14 Wilder on 5m bars, value at the decision bar close
entry.admission: AM1: one plan per pair whatever the side; a filled plan reserves the pair until decision_close + horizon (every method is flat by then), an unfilled plan until decision_close + ttl

execution.decision_time: 5m bar close, from the fill bar on
execution.decision_effect: from the first 1m candle of the next 5m bar (latency 0); sensitivity: one bar later (latency 1)
execution.initial_target_check_from: candle after the fill candle; one-tick trade-through (AM2); sensitivity target_touch_legacy: on a touch
execution.moved_target: new limit order: one-tick trade-through from the first candle of the bar after the modification (latency 0)
execution.tie: stop first when stop and target are touched in the same 1m candle
execution.stop_fill_price: worse of the stop level and the candle open (gaps)
execution.market_exit: open of the effective candle; taker fee + stop_spread_rate + stop_slippage_rate
execution.stop_guarantee: none: stops fill at the worse of the level and the candle open; costs are assumptions
execution.rounding: stops rounded away from the market (long down), break-even level rounded up (long), targets rounded away from the entry

costs.doubled: baseline with every spread rate x2 (costs.doubled_spread)
costs.status: hypothetical OHLCV costs (fake local fee policy, not historical Binance fees)

statistics.unit: net R = net_quote / stop_risk_quote (identical risk across methods)

bootstrap.kind: block by UTC day of the decision

continue_if_all: improvement: paired difference (B-A or C-A) Holm-rejected with a one-sided Holm lower bound > 0 (baseline)
profitable: the method's own mean net R > 0 with a day-block 90% lower bound > 0 (baseline, comparison 1)
robust_costs: adverse profile method mean net R > 0 and paired mean difference > 0

risk_within_limits: drawdown of cumulative net R in exit order <= 20 R (comparison 1), the method's realistic portfolio takes at least one trade, realized drawdown share <= 0.25 at 1000 USDT (comparison 2, baseline)

power.explanation: AM9: min_trades 3000 = own-mean n without design effect (2993, sd 1.1 R, delta 0.05 R, alpha 0.05 one-sided, power 0.8) rounded up; the design effect 1.5 (day clustering) applies to every calculation in the confirmation (own mean 4489, paired 1336); min_days 250: judgement floor (about one year of trading days) so that the day-block bootstrap rests on enough independent clusters and the sample spans several regimes; not derived from a formula

data_split.exploration: Binance USD-M 10 majors 1m 2023-01-01 -> 2025-01-01 (consumed; development only; owner authorization 2026-10-21)
data_split.confirmation: TO BE DESIGNATED BY THE OWNER: Binance intraday 2020-2022 (unread in the register, possibly_independent, to download) or OKX X-Perps prospective capture from 2026-11-02

evidence_status: EXPLORATION_ONLY: Binance 2023-2024 is consumed development data; no result on it can confirm a strategy or count as an independent validation

amendments.what: Common admission merges both sides of a pair: one plan per pair whatever the side; a bar with both a long and a short decision drops both (counted)
amendments.why: the v1 table was built per side and allowed a long and a short on the same pair at once

amendments.what: Every target (initial and moved) is a resting limit credited only on a one-tick trade-through, from the candle after the fill (initial) or from the effective candle (moved); the v1 convention (initial target on a touch) is kept as the sensitivity target_touch_legacy
amendments.why: same execution assumption for fixed and moved targets in the main analysis

amendments.what: A stop level that is not at least one tick on the protective side of the decision close cannot rest as a stop: the position exits at market at the effective open (reason stop_crossed, market-exit costs); a valid stop that the effective candle opens through fills at the open (worse of level and open)
amendments.why: never credit a fill at a level the market has already passed

amendments.what: Comparison 2 (realistic portfolio) added: each method walks the full S1 candidate list; the pair and the exposure are released at the method's own exit; unfilled entry orders reserve the pair and their notional until the TTL end; same capital and risk rules (budgets: 1 % of realized equity at risk, open notional <= 2 x equity, steps and minimums) for the three methods; also run at the reference size without capital
amendments.why: the common 60-minute reservation suppresses entries that an early exit would allow

amendments.what: Portfolio drawdown = maximum over settlements of (running peak - equity) / running peak on realized equity, settlements in exit order; unrealized losses are not measured (max_open_risk_share bounds them, gaps excepted)
amendments.why: v1 used the largest absolute fall divided by the final peak, and settled positions in decision order

amendments.what: Verdict fails closed: a missing, non-finite or invalid measure never becomes zero and never passes; a method whose portfolio takes no trade cannot pass; labels: IMPROVEMENT_PROFITABLE_SUPPORTED, IMPROVEMENT_PROFITABLE_NOT_ROBUST (improvement and profitable but adverse costs or risk limits fail), IMPROVEMENT_BUT_NOT_PROFITABLE, NO_IMPROVEMENT_DEMONSTRATED, INSUFFICIENT_DATA; per method the four properties are reported separately
amendments.why: a positive but too risky method is not loss-making; an undemonstrated improvement is not proof of no effect

amendments.what: Funding is required: every 8-hour funding time inside a trade must be in the data (within one minute) or the run stops; no unknown funding or cost becomes zero

Break-even level = entry plus the assumed total round-trip cost of the baseline profile (maker 2 bp, taker 5 bp, stop spread 2 bp, stop slippage 5 bp: about 14 bp); an assumption, not a guarantee of a loss-free exit

Power: the 3000-trade floor is the own-mean calculation without design effect (2993); with the design effect 1.5 it is 4489; the paired comparisons need 891 (1336 with 1.5); the floors 3000 trades and 250 days are kept; the variability and the day-cluster design effect are re-estimated on the exploration data and the confirmation minimum is max(floor, re-estimated requirement)
The 20 R and 25 % limits are research criteria of the verdict, not automatic stops: the replay does not halt trading when they are crossed; the 1000 USDT account is a simulation scenario

funding.source: Binance USD-M fundingRate archives in the cache

portfolio.reference_size_variant: no capital, reference notional 250 USDT, pair release only

data.authorization: owner message 2026-10-21: local Binance USD-M 10 majors 2023-2024, 1m candles + funding + instrument metadata, development only; no download
data.cache: tradingV3-private/research/20261012T003000Z-explore-v2/cache (manifest f532dfab...); only the authorized window is sliced in memory, warm-up included (no 2022 or 2025 row is used)
data.prior_use: the same period and pairs were consumed by the v2 scalping screen (S1 among 36 5m configurations, all negative, median -0.30 R); this exploration is a new trial on consumed data

trial_count.this_run: 3 methods x 1 parameter set, 1 run; sensitivities are not separate trials
trial_count.rule: any later change of parameters, rules or data after reading this run's performance counts as a new trial and is numbered
